The options are combinations of the three.

distractor_analysis.mechanism: conceptual confusion: symmetry read as forcing the function to be positive, so the integral statement is accepted
sign error: the symmetry taken to make the endpoint derivatives equal rather than opposite
sign error: the symmetry taken to make the endpoint derivatives equal rather than opposite
conceptual confusion: symmetry read as forcing positivity, together with the endpoint sign error
